name: Drone
description: Sustained tones that never sit still: each key is a small ensemble of partials in a just-intoned shape, every one wandering in pitch, level and pan, with a sub octave, tuned air and a latch.

params.name: Shape
params.description: The intervals the partials form above each key: unison, octaves, fifths, the harmonic series, a pure major or minor chord, or a cluster.

params.name: Partials
params.description: How many of the upper partials sound, brought in one after another. It changes the colour of the drone, not its loudness.

params.name: Wave
params.description: Morphs every partial from a pure sine through a triangle to a bright sawtooth.

params.name: Movement
params.description: How far every partial wanders in pitch, level and pan, and how far the filter drifts. At zero the drone stands still.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How fast the partials wander, from a gradual drift to a restless flutter. Has no effect with Movement at zero.

params.name: Sub
params.description: Level of a steady sine one octave below each key, in the centre, for weight under the partials.

params.name: Air
params.description: Level of noise filtered to a narrow band at each key's pitch: a tuned, breathy layer over the tones.

params.name: Cutoff
params.description: Low-pass over the whole drone. Lower is darker and softer; higher lets the upper partials and the air through.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a key takes to fade in. Long times let a drone rise slowly out of silence.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a drone takes to fade out once its key is released, or once Hold lets it go.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the partials and the air spread across the stereo field. At zero the drone is mono.

params.name: Hold
params.description: On keeps a drone sounding after its key is released. Pressing the same key again, or switching to Off, lets it fade out.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The shapes are just-intonation ratio sets; the sine, triangle and sawtooth cycles are built additively at init and stored band-limited per octave.
